title: Corelle Livingware True Blue  8.5 plates
text: Corelle Livingware True Blue  8.5 plates. These arrived... all is well... until I loaded them into the dishwasher and noticed that one of the plates had a ceramic flaw - a blue drop that is forever sealed in the glaze.  Now.  It doesn't effect the "use" of the plate... however, the bright blue on white is constantly being picked at to see if some food or other thing stuck on the plate!  The blue of course stands out on the white very brightly.  So... Amazon of course made this right.  But disappointing to have that one plate that I just got rid of because it is so frustrating.  Wish the factory would have caught this before sending it out.  It was an obvious factory flaw as it is under the glaze.
